question: According to Census of India 2011, which state recorded the second highest literacy rate in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mizoram**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mizoram** recorded the second highest literacy rate in India according to the Census of India 2011.
 
• The literacy rate of Mizoram was **91.33%**, which was second only to Kerala.
 
• Kerala had the highest literacy rate at **93.91%**.
 
• Mizoram&am
